How to activate a CD key or code on PS5?

  • Option A: Via the mobile app or a web browser (Fastest method)

    1. Open the PS App on your smartphone (or log into the official store.playstation.com website using a web browser).

    2. Navigate to the main store page, then open the options menu (usually by tapping your profile avatar or the three horizontal lines icon).

    3. Select the "Redeem Code" option, enter your unique 12-character key, and confirm. You can even trigger a remote download to your console if it is in Rest Mode.

  • Option B: Directly on your PS5 console (Recommended method)

    1. Turn on your console and launch the PlayStation Store application from the dashboard.

    2. In the store's left sidebar menu, scroll down near the bottom and select "Redeem Codes".

    3. Carefully enter your unique 12-character code (without spaces or hyphens), then select "Continue".

    4. Confirm the activation on the product summary page. The game is now permanently linked to your account. You can start downloading it right away or find it later in your "Library" > "Purchased" section.
